tactics.title: Establish and approve the purpose boundary
tactics.objective: Create an attributable purpose, use boundary and ownership record.
tactics.use_when: A locked finding shows that purpose, allowed use, excluded use or accountable ownership is missing or inconsistent.
activities: Define intended outcomes, permitted uses and excluded uses.
Name the accountable owner and approval authority.
acceptance_criteria: Purpose and ownership are explicit, attributable and consistent with implementation.
verification: Independent governance review against the assessed implementation.
do_not_use_when: The issue is solely a technical security-control failure.
tactics.blocks_transition: Deployment remains blocked until the accepted artifacts are independently verified and reassessed.
